songs.t: Chhanake Hay Moree Payaliya, Khanake Kangana Daiya Re Daiya
O Mere Dil Jisase Mil Ke Too Hai Itana Beqarar
Aa Ja Tere Khabon Kee Taqadeer Jaga Doon, Chhalaka Hua Paimana Hay
Aankhon Men Kajara Balon Men Gajara, Dil Tumane Loota Hamara
Tujhe Main Sanam Dhoonata Hoon, Mere Hamaqadam Dhoonata Hoon, Are Kuchh To Bata
Mere Dost, Ai Mere Hamanasheen, Mujhe Tujhase Koee Gila Naheen
Yah Jo Dil Mangate Hain Bade Daghabaz Hain
Churate Ho Nazaren Ajee Kisaliye, Ki Zinda Hain Bas Aap Hee Ke Lie...
Mere Dil Zindagee Safar Hai, Meree Jan Kal Pe Kyoon Nazar Hai
Nazaren Mila Ke Aapane Ehasan Kar Diya, Phir Se Hamare Jeene Ka Saman Kar Diya...
Sabase Ho Aala Meree Jan Jalava Nirala Qurban, Apana Bana Ke Dekho
Ba-4 Dil Janab Ke Qadamon Men Ham Nisar To Kar Denge
Dil Aavara, Kare Nazara, Dil Aavara Kare Nazara Achchhee Sooratavalon Ka
Hae Hae Dil Javanee Men Sambhalo, Naya Hai Rasta
Ai Aa Ha Kare Vo Kya, Kya, Kya Ki Jisako Pyar Ho Gaya
Na Mano To Koee Shikayat Naheen, Magar Yah Na Kahana Muhabbat Naheen, Na Mano To...
